title: PAS: An Efficient Block-Wise Scheduling Framework for Diffusion LLM Serving (artifact)
description: Artifact for the PPoPP 2027 paper. Reproduces the end-to-end serving comparison of PAS (CW_SRPT_V3) against the SGLang LowConfidence baseline on LLaDA2.0-mini 16B BF16, on 2x A100 40 GB, TP=2. A single entry point provisions a locked environment, downloads the public checkpoint with per-file SHA-256 verification, and runs four stages: a controlled-load sweep, a four-dataset load sweep, an Azure trace replay, and a GSM8K quality check. Public evaluation sets (GSM8K, MGSM, HumanEval prompts, MT-Bench prompts) and a 30-minute Azure trace window are bundled with provenance and licences. The Kimi trace used in the paper is confidential and is not included.
